item_ancient_arrow_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Despite its gnarled look, this arrow is perfectly effective in both practice and in combat.
item_arbalist_bronze_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. The Bronze Reinforced Crossbow is a huge improvement over its smaller predecessor power, but a bit more unwieldy.
item_arrow_chitin_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Not as sharp as other arrows, but good against skeletons.
item_arrow_greenmetal_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A piercing darkness, may your aim be true.
item_arrow_surtlingfire_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. An arrow, adorned with a surting core at its tip. It's fire, bound to burn anything it pierces.
item_atgeir_antler_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A branch from Eikthyr's crown, it sits still sparking. Some call it the Antlergier.
item_atgeir_chitin_heavy_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A chitinous atgeir, fit for the bravest of seafarers.
item_atgeir_flint_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A crudely fashioned pole with a clumsily attached piece of flint.
item_axe_flametal_1h_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. This gnarled axe seems brimming with potential.
item_axe_flametal_1h_description_blood: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. This sinister axe is dripping in energy after being fused with a red gemstone.
item_axe_flametal_1h_description_lightni: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A storm of its own kind.
item_axe_flametal_1h_description_primal: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Twising roots and strong poisons fall on your enemies.
item_battleaxe_antler_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Twin antlers sharpened and chained. You can still feel Eikthyr's life sparking from the blades.
item_battleaxe_blackmetal_herkir_descrip: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Giant Killer, fire bringer, pain maker.
item_battleaxe_bronze_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. An especially large bronze axe, great for removing both heads and trees alike.
item_battleaxe_flint_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Two rough flint blades haphazardly attached to a large sturdy log.
item_blackmetal_2h_axe_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Twin edges glisten in the light, their strucken greenish hue appear like a whirlwhind of impeding death.
item_blackmetal_greatsword_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Forged with gleaming blackmetal. It catches the light with a greenish glow.
item_bolt_bronze_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Bronze crossbow bolts a bit sharper than corewood.
item_bolt_corewood_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A sturdy wooden bolt.
item_bolt_fire_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. This bolt burns whatever it pierces.
item_bolt_iron_poison_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A sharp bolt tipped with poison, if the bolt doesn't kill - the poison surely will.
item_bolt_obsidian_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A shard of complete darkness.
item_bolt_silver_frost_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Silver bolts, encased in ice. Deadly to both the fiery and dead alike.
item_bolt_surtling_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A bolt, adorned with a surting core at its tip. It's fire, bound to burn anything it pierces.
item_bolt_wood_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A little more than a single sharpened stick. Still entirely capable of its purpose.
item_bone_arrow_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Just giving a greydwarf a bone.
item_bonemass_axe_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A jagged edge embedded in a foul skull.
item_bonemass_dagger_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A thin, iron blade. Coated in poison, embellished by the bones of the dead.
item_bonemass_greatsword_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive ancient bone sharpened to a fine point. For some reason, you decided it needed to be mounted on a skull.
item_bonemass_warhammer_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A mighty warhammer made from skulls of the dead imbued with the hatred of bonemass.
item_bow_antler_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. The herald of lightning, may all hear of Eikthyr's thunder.
item_bow_blackmetal_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Linen thread stengthens its draw, blackmetal gleams, eager for an arrow.
item_bow_bone_blood_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. The bow crafted from corewood and bones has a nasty air, it does not require arrows, but siphons the archers blood in exchange.
item_bow_heavy_bone_blood_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. This bow seems absolutely rapid for blood, and dangerously evil.
item_bow_pincer_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive bow made from two of the Queens pincers takes a large amount of energy to pull taught, but it packs quite the punch.
item_bronze_greatsword_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A dealer of death, it's touch remains quite potent. However, it is still not the most durable.
item_bronze_sledge_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A giant stone adorned by bronze, and further held in place by straps of sturdy troll hide.
item_crossbow_blackmetal_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. An extremely sturdy crossbow, a pinacle of engineering and death.
item_crossbow_bronze_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A simple bronze crossbow, powerful but fragile.
item_crossbow_elder_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. living vines, strung together to act as a powerful force of nature. Hopefully they don't continue to grow further.
item_crossbow_iron_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A sturdy crossbow, rugged and tough to load.
item_crossbow_moder_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A double compound bow, powered by a core of Moder's tears.
item_crossbow_wood_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A crude bow attached to a sturdy log, slow to load.
item_crystal_axe_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Made of apparent see-through crystal. They say you can see your own death. Enchroaching crystalline death.
item_dagger_antler_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A sharpened shard made from Eikthyr's antlers, it is still teeming with electricity.
item_dagger_blackmetal_mistlands_descrip: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Hati seeks the moon and your enemies hearts.
item_dagger_bronze_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Ever eviscerating, the unrelenting wound letter.
item_dagger_bronze_description_2h: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Now you just need to start leveling your pickpocket skill.
item_dagger_chitin_2h_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. You wield the serpents fangs.
item_dagger_copper_description_2h: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A pair of glistening  knives, what will they slice?
item_dagger_flint_2h_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Lightweight and quite flimsy. Two make a better pair than one.
item_dagger_iron_2h_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A pair of two is better than any individual, even more potent for their original purpose.
item_dagger_iron_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A warriors adept tool for rending flesh. Bringer of death.
item_dagger_meteor_2h_blood_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. These blades are eager for more blood.
item_dagger_meteor_2h_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Two slivers of darkness sneak through the night, what will they find?
item_dagger_meteor_2h_lightning_descript: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Strikes like thunder, fast as lightning.
item_dagger_meteor_2h_nature_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Vines bind your target, nothing escapes these blades.
item_dagger_meteor_blood_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A razor sharp knife with a sinister aura, it constantly drips blood.
item_dagger_meteor_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Dark as the night, balanced perfectly.
item_dagger_meteor_lightning_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A razor sharp knife crackling with lightning.
item_dagger_meteor_primal_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A razor sharp knife imbued with natures primal qualities.
item_dagger_moder_2h_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A pair of glistening shards of ice, graceful deathbringers.
item_dagger_moder_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. An ice cold dagger, frozen by Moder's tears.
item_dagger_queen_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A shard from the queens massive carapace, sharpened it still glistens with her magic.
item_dagger_silver_2h_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Men and beast alike fear the slice and dice.
item_dagger_silver_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Purest of metals, friend and foe alike should fear you. Nothing unclean can abide its touch.
item_dual_axes_blackmetal_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Dark and shimmering alike. Their beauty catches the light with a greenish light.
item_dual_axes_bonemass_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Sinister jagged blades, burning with hatred and fury.
item_dual_axes_bronze_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Foe feller, enemy and tree alike should fear you.
item_dual_axes_crystal_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Brilliantly shimmering dual blades of crystal. Ever ensaring, the shimmering touch of death.
item_dual_axes_flint_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Flimsy, and quite crudely fashioned. Capable of quick, relentless attacks.
item_dual_axes_iron_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Inevitable, little can stand in the way of any warrior with each of these axes hand-in-hand.
item_dual_axes_jotun_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Twice the poison, twice the pain!
item_dual_axes_moder_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Twin axes frozen in time.
item_dverger_tower_shield_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Likeness of a giant, this tower shield uses a copper encased blackcore mist disperser.
item_elder_mace_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A large rock held by living vines, it still calls for its saplings.
item_elder_roundshield_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Vines from the Elder, Stained with its blood. It has become a twisted force of superb blunt resistance.
item_fist_bronze_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Bronze spikes, backed by corewood. Perfect for fisticuffs.
item_fist_flint_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Flint pebbles, safely secured within handy chunks of wood. Quite flimsy, but will do well enough.
item_fist_iron_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Bloodthirsty, the fine many blades. The perfect line between life and death.
item_fist_yagluth_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Shards of the goblin-kings crown, secured tightly around iron. Further guarded by blackmetal.
item_flametal_2h_axe_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Heavy flametal blades, shimmering whirling death.
item_flametal_2h_axe_description_blood: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Soaked in glistening red energy, this axe hungers for blood.
item_flametal_2h_axe_description_lightni: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Cackling energies fly as it cuts through the air.
item_flametal_2h_axe_description_primal: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive flametal axe, radiating from a green gems magic.
item_flint_greatsword_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Flint, shaped into a large crude blade. It's not very sturdy, but its weight remains strenous.
item_flint_mace_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Rough flint stacked and tied on a sturdy stick.
item_greatsword_fader_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive sword forged from Faders gift. It burns the dead and living alike.
item_iron_greatsword_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Atop the massive blade, runs the fine point between life and death alike.
item_jotun_2h_axe_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A true giant slayer, nothing may survive its bite.
item_jotunn_halfaxe_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Not even the giants of old could weather the poisonous bite of this weapon.
item_knife_blackmetal_2h_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Blades of incredible aptitude, both beautifully brilliant and deadly. It catches the light with a greenish glow.
item_meteor_atgeir_blood_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. The dual blades hunger for blood.
item_meteor_atgeir_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Why use one blade, when you could use two?
item_meteor_atgeir_lightning_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Its blades crackle with energy, just one touch and sparks fly.
item_meteor_atgeir_nature_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Primal energy flows through these blades, binding your foes.
item_mistland_mace_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. What better way to squash bugs?
item_moder_axe_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. An axe blade carved from pure ice held with moders tears.
item_moder_buckler_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Etched with the blood of the frost dragon. This shield reduces frost damage while blocking.
item_moder_greatsword_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Forged by eternal ice, emboldened by the raw power of the frost dragon.
item_moder_shield_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A shield encased over eternal ice, emboldened by the raw power of the frost dragon.
item_needle_bolt_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A stitch in time.
item_pickaxe_blood_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. This pickaxe seems unnaturally strong, and hungry for your blood.
item_queen_greatsword_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive pincer from the sealed queen herself, still further does it seem to twitch a little now and then.
item_serpent_buckler_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A flexible, wooden-iron woven shield. A fronted by an array of shiny scales.
item_silver_atgeir_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Its curved silver blade braced with obsidian, a beasthunters favorite weapon.
item_silver_greatsword_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Purest of metals, forged with silver and wrought iron alike. Nothing unclean can abide its touch.
item_silver_sledge_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A mammoth-like silver hammer. Let its weight strike fear into the undead.
item_silver_tower_shield_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A giant tower shield framed with silver, a monster hunters bulwark.
item_sledge_blackmetal_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Heavy chunks of blackmetal fused with thunderstones. Causes lightning strikes. A warhammer worth its weight
item_sledge_elder_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive stone fused together and held by living vines of the Elder, stained with its blood.
item_sledge_flametal_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive sledge, well designed and carefully balanced. Powerful, and just as heavy.
item_sledge_flametal_description_blood: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive sledge, its rage seems to grow the more dire the fight.
item_sledge_flametal_description_lightni: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive sledge, twin storms, shocking to the touch.
item_sledge_flametal_description_nature: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A massive sledge, dripping with natures energy, with this you could stop an army.
item_spear_blackmetal_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A dark, curved blade. Secured around knots of chain, it catches the light with a greenish glow.
item_spear_fader_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Crafted from the body of Fader, it still burns earily and hungrily.
item_spear_moder_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Made in mind, its fine blade consisting of eteneral ice. Seemingly retained by the encasement of Moder herself.
item_staff_druid_fire_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Carefully contained, and now mounted on a druidic staff. May you wield the power of fire.
item_staff_druid_ice_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A freezing druidic staff made from mountains many ice crystals. May you wield the power of ice.
item_staff_druid_poison_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Comprised of exceptional essence derivative of the swamp, with great focus, may you create potent poison from it.
item_staff_druid_spirit_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A Druids staff made from magical items from the black forest, undead are wary of it.
item_staff_poison_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A capable staff built from ancient wood, it reeks of poison it has been soaked in for ages.
item_staff_spirit_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A staff crafted from the essence of the Elders spirit. The dead fear the lingering voices of the spirit.
item_sword_antler_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Consisting of many twisted antlers of the crown, bound by both the chains and the power from Eikthyr's remains.
item_sword_bonemass_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A ragged iron blade fused with dreadful bones from the swamp.
item_sword_chitin_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Unbridled ferocity, deep below the waves.
item_sword_fader_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A sword crafted from Faders remains, it burns with necrotic magic.
item_sword_flint_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Made from the best flint you could find, however, it's still quite flimsy.
item_sword_moder_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Made from the eternal ice of the frost dragon. Perpetually chilled by the raw power her remains have left you.
item_sword_queen_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Sharpened carapace from the queen of bugs, the queen. It continues to further radiate magical energies.
item_sword_vine_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A carefully balanced stone blade. Fused together with the living vines of the Elder.
item_yagluth_atgeir_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A fragment of Yagluths crown, mounted on a pike. It still emits an undying firey anger.
item_yagluth_greatsword_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. A giant blade crafted from wrought blackmetal, as well as the remains of Yagluth himself.
va_blood_sucker_desc: Your weapon is eager for blood.
va_item_crossbow_silver_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Dark wood braced with silver, it glistens in the moonlight.
va_item_soulstealer_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. What price are you willing to pay?
va_modershield_resistance_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. Moder's shield is granting you a large resistance to frost, and a small resistance to fire.'
va_nature_immobilized_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. You are stuck.
va_queen_buff_desc: The queens power flows through you, you feel energized and healthy.
va_staff_eitr_buff_desc: This magica staff is granting you access to a small amount of Eitr
va_vineshield_resistance_description: Trang bị chiến binh uy lực. The Elders vineshield is granting you strong resistances to spirit and poison.
